title: Date filter component audit
purpose: Audit date as a browser-native date/range control with validation and styling limits.
objective: Define date anatomy, from/to behavior, native picker limitations, validation states, responsive behavior, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: from input, to input, labels/placeholders, native picker behavior, range validation, focus/disabled/invalid states, responsive behavior, and QA scenario. Out of scope: custom calendar picker implementation and other filter types.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current date render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A date audit sheet exists with native constraints, validation behavior, and safe controls prioritized.

phases.title: Validation
phases.purpose: Define range and invalid state behavior.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source changes are made.
